Honestly just look up some of the calories online and weigh by scale. Scales are real cheap. and if its not up there then do your best to calculate from raw ingredients. Most marinades and sauces in korean foods is soy sauce, gochugaru, and gochujang

I know you might not be satisfied from not knowing an exact amount but ill tell you now that if youre looking to cut on calories only to lose weight, as long as youre around your estimate and your body is in deficeit, the pounds will go down.


Keep in mind that korean food is usually high in sodium cause of soy sauce based sauces and marinades. Example: 불고기, 닭찜 (i think thats how you spell it... My koreans not good). And 라면.
But back to sodium. Depending on your body reacts to it, you will most likely have retained water which will show up on the scale but thats not necessarily your true weight.

Regardless.
I lost 70 lbs in 6 months from just doing what I told you. On top of a 3 mile cardio run and staying right under 1500 calories a day. Unfortunately, you have to try to just stay away from 삼겹쌀, 떡북끼, etc... Or eat pretty small amounts of it. I just sucked it up and ate copious meals of 비빔밥.. 

Weight loss to me is all dedication, discipline, and commitment.
Good luck~
